settings.label: Default Share Image
settings.info: Used when sharing non-product pages (home, about, etc.) on social media. Recommended: 1200×630px.

settings.label: Google Analytics ID
settings.info: Your GA4 Measurement ID. Leave blank to disable.

settings.content: This sets the default gallery mode for ALL product pages. Individual products can override it via Theme Editor → Product Hero → Gallery Mode.

settings.label: Default Gallery Mode (all PDPs)

options.label: Slideshow — thumbnails + one image at a time
Scroll Stack — all images stacked, scroll through
Grid (H&M style) — 1st image full width, rest in 2-col grid

settings.info: Grid mode mimics the H&M PDP: the first image is full-width, remaining images display as side-by-side pairs in a 2-column grid. No thumbnail strip is shown. The product info panel stays sticky as you scroll through images.

settings.content: These settings only apply when Default Gallery Mode is set to Grid.

settings.label: Border Radius
settings.info: Controls the corner roundness of cards, buttons, badges, inputs, and the gallery site-wide. 0 = sharp corners. 15 = softly rounded (default). 30 = pill-shaped.
